title: Power Apps: GitHub-connected models and wider Maker Studio availability for generative pages
summary: The briefing passes: its rollout targets and GitHub credit consumption match the roadmap, and the documented tenant control is correctly limited to the separate canvas authoring agent. Searches found no published generative-page GitHub control, default, credit rate or data-flow specification; the briefing keeps those uncertainties explicit.
